verdict.rationale: SendGrid's Inbound Parse webhook is documented to parse the contents and attachments of incoming email and POST that data to a URL of your choice. A community user also reports using SendGrid inbound, noting a hiccup with its SPF/DKIM checks, which corroborates the feature exists rather than contradicting it. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of the MX-record setup step, explicit mention of parsed headers in the payload, and an API retrieval option beyond the webhook.
